integrity: Proof is analytic for all integers m>=2; packaged Python enumeration uses exact rationals on finitely many test cases and is not an infinite proof. No external independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proof covers homogeneous nearest-neighbor exclusion only, for sites with gaps (m,m,m+1). Existence/uniqueness is local for all sufficiently large m; finite-size global uniqueness is not proved. Full text of one secondary 1986 correlation article was inaccessible; earlier unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
title: An alternating finite-ring three-point correlation boundary near fugacity two
